methodology.purpose: exploratory historical baseline; forward daily data remains out-of-sample validation
methodology.universe: current TWSE/TPEx universe; survivorship bias possible
methodology.price_source: Yahoo Finance daily chart, OHLC adjusted by adjclose/close factor
methodology.limit_up_note: historical limit-up close approximated as adjusted close return >=9.5%; validate important rows against official data
methodology.mother_filter: MA5/10/20 spread <=3%; D0 return >0; D0 close above MA5/10/20
exit_rules: intraday high reaches +20%: sell half of current remaining at +20%
close below MA5: sell half of current remaining
close below MA10: sell all remaining
